title: AVS Scout
tagline: Create your own personal DeFAI agent with privacy secured by AVS!
description:
Scout Agentic is a decentralized platform designed to enable users to create and deploy DeFAI (Decentralized AI) Agents that perform on-chain actions autonomously. These agents operate in a secure, trustless environment and are hosted by AVS (Actively Validated Services) Operators on EigenLayer.

Users provide contextual information to define their agent’s behavior, and the DeFAI Agents interact with smart contracts on the blockchain to execute actions. The system is secured through AVS Operators, who ensure execution, while validators stake assets to provide an insurance mechanism—slashed if they act maliciously or fail to execute correctly.

Key Features:
User-Customized DeFAI Agents – Users define their agent's logic and parameters.
On-Chain Execution – Agents interact directly with blockchain smart contracts.
AVS Hosting & Validation – Operators ensure reliability and security.
Slashing-Based Insurance – Validators are penalized for failures, ensuring accountability.
how_its_made:
Tech Stack & Components
This project integrates multiple decentralized and AI-driven technologies, working together to provide an efficient, secure, and autonomous on-chain execution environment.

Core Technologies Used:
Solidity (Smart Contracts)

Used to define the on-chain logic for DeFAI Agent execution, AVS validation, and slashing conditions.
Contracts manage agent registration, execution, and fund allocation.
EigenLayer (AVS Hosting)

AVS Operators host the DeFAI Agents and ensure reliable execution.
Validators stake assets and get slashed if they fail to execute correctly.
AgentKit (AI Agents for Execution)

AgentKit provides modular AI-driven automation for DeFAI Agents.
AI logic determines the optimal on-chain actions based on user input.
Blockchain Integration (Ethereum / L2s like Base, Scroll, or Starknet)

Transactions are executed directly on-chain.
DeFAI Agents interact with smart contracts for DeFi operations.
